title: Activation Response
description: Schema for POST /__remote_everything_activate response. Shared by Go, Kotlin, Swift, and ArkTS strict decoders.

ok.description: Whether activation succeeded and the node is reachable.

computer_connected.description: Whether the gateway can reach the node.

code.description: Status code. 'ready' means activated and node reachable. 'approval_pending' means waiting for manual approval. 'computer_offline' means node unreachable.

apps.description: App list returned only on successful activation (code=ready).
